Log artifacts at the record or documentation section level during your validation process.

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] The record you want to log artifacts on is registered in the inventory.[^1]
- [x] Development documentation is completed or in progress for your record.[^2]
- [x] You are a [{{< fa circle-check >}} Validator]{.bubble} or assigned another role with sufficient permissions to perform the tasks in this guide.[^3]

:::

## Add artifacts on documentation

{{< include _add-artifacts-on-documentation.qmd >}}

## Add artifacts on validation reports

While assessing a record's compliance,[^4] you can add artifacts as you complete your validation report:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa cubes >}} Inventory**.

2. Select a record or find your record by applying a filter or searching for it.[^5]

3. In the left sidebar that appears for your record, click **{{< fa file >}} Documents** and select the **Latest** tab.[^6]

4. Click on a Validation type file.[^7]

   Expand any subsection of the validation report you have attached evidence for to autogenerate validation issues or manually link artifacts to your report:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Autogenerate validation issues

{{< include _autogenerate-validation-issues.qmd >}}

### Manually add artifacts

:::

## Bulk upload artifacts via API {#bulk-upload-artifacts-via-api}

To add many artifacts at once through the {{< var vm.product >}} API, such as validation issues, limitations or policy exceptions from another tool, use the bulk upload artifacts notebook.[^8] It reads a `.xlsx` or `.csv` file with one artifact per row and adds each artifact to the record named in that row, or all of them to one record.

The notebook checks every row in a dry run before creating anything, then creates the artifacts. Rows that match an artifact of the same type and title already on the record are skipped, so you can safely run the same file again. The notebook reports the result of each row and saves the failed rows to a file you can fix and upload again.

The notebook signs in with your API key and secret.[^9] To create the records first, use the bulk upload inventory records notebook.[^10]

::: {.callout-important title="Uploaded artifacts start workflows."}
Each artifact you upload starts any workflow your organization runs when an artifact of that type is created. Check with the workflow's owner before uploading many artifacts at once.
:::
